name: 27295 · Lexington, NC
findings: ZIP 27295 (Lexington) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 15 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27295 (Lexington) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27295 (Lexington) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 44% of the typical level).
